title: Durable mutation queue restart and replay performance scenario
description: Each stratum creates the exact durable mutation count, restarts the client, loses one response, and replays one terminal rejection.

parameters.scenario: push an ordered batch containing accepted and rejected mutations
parameters.defect: omit, duplicate, cross-list, reorder, or assign an unspecified status to a requested mutation

parameters.scenario: capture a local mutation and force queue processing to stop before send
parameters.defect: remove the intent without pending, accepted, rejected, superseded, cancelled, or blocked outcome linkage

injection.target: local action replay and echo deduplication

parameters.scenario: replay a sealed response and then deliver the authoritative row echo
parameters.defect: enqueue or apply the same logical local action a second time

injection.target: durable queue commit before first transmission

parameters.scenario: kill the client after queue persistence and before network transmission
parameters.defect: regenerate mutation identity or lose authored content and local ordering on restart

injection.target: pre-connect manifest, seed base, and mutation queue

parameters.scenario: write offline with a verified manifest, then use a seed receipt that is unassigned or stale
parameters.defect: fabricate a base version, lose authored intent, or expose writes without a verified table and field manifest

parameters.scenario: change a queued mutation after schema or application reconciliation and separately leave one unchanged
parameters.defect: reuse the original UUID for changed intent or remove unchanged UUID and authored content

parameters.scenario: drop a request after transmission and before a retryable response
parameters.defect: commit queue, cursor, schema, rebuild, or partial-page state beyond retry bookkeeping

parameters.scenario: attempt stopped-to-pulling, error-to-ready, and an unknown state transition
parameters.defect: accept the unlisted transition or mutate durable state before returning a non-retryable local contract error

parameters.scenario: queue insert-update-delete chains before sealing and update/delete after a sealed predecessor
parameters.defect: send fabricated base_version, drop predecessor linkage, or create a transient server row for unsealed insert-delete

assertions.description: The ordered workload produces the complete authored durable semantic outcome without partial state.
Every declared budget or measurement records all configured strata and required metrics.
Native queue inspection proves that each authored mutation retains one linked pending or terminal outcome.
Response replay and authoritative echo leave one local action and one durable outcome.
Native queue inspection preserves stable mutation identifiers, authored content, and order across process restart.
Verified offline schema metadata permits writes before first connect and preserves their durable queue identities.
Unchanged queued intent retains its identity and authored content across restart, while changed intent creates one linked successor and preserves its original.
A retryable lost response changes only retry bookkeeping before the exact queued mutation resumes.
The native state trace follows only declared adjacency edges and rejects unknown or unlisted transitions.
Same-row intent resolves before transmission without fabricated versions or an unsealed transient server row.
